title: Slurm Workload Manager variables
description: Configuration variables for Slurm HPC/AI cluster controller and compute node daemons

SLURM_VERSION.description: Specific version of Slurm Workload Manager to install.

SLURM_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install Slurm ('libscript_native' isolates binaries in LIBSCRIPT_HOME, 'system' uses OS packages).

SLURM_CTLD_PORT.description: TCP port on which the Slurm controller daemon (slurmctld) listens.

SLURM_D_PORT.description: TCP port on which the Slurm compute node daemon (slurmd) listens.

SLURM_STATE_DIR.description: Filesystem directory path for Slurm controller job state and spool files.

SLURM_HOME.description: Filesystem directory or path configuration for slurm (SLURM_HOME).
